function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute CLI command: adb shell (device), sql (database), http (backend), read-file, write-file, find-files

steps.message: Please help me sync the Security announcement from mike in the announcement channel on mattermost to mastodon,

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name LIKE '%announce%' OR displayname LIKE '%announce%'"

steps.message: Read messages from mike in the announcement channel

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT message FROM posts WHERE channelid='{channel_id}' AND userid=(SELECT id FROM users WHERE username='mike') AND deleteat=0 ORDER BY createat DESC LIMIT 5"

results.content: Security: rotated API keys; check 1Password vault for updated entries.

steps.message: Get Mastodon auth token from device database

arguments.command: sql /data/data/org.joinmastodon.android.mastodon/databases/accounts.db "SELECT token FROM accounts WHERE id LIKE '%_115338428522805842'"

steps.message: Post the announcement on Mastodon as followers-only, mentioning @openCompany

arguments.command: http POST https://10.0.2.2/api/v1/statuses --headers "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --headers "Host: 10.0.2.2" --headers "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"status":"@openCompany Security: rotated API keys; check 1Password vault for updated entries.","visibility":"private"}'
